# Tree UI Demo

This script explains what is happening in the accompanying video:

* 0:00 - 0:02 - Opens with the Pruned Tree visible, it contains ~98,000 nodes and is zoomed out.
* 0:02 - 0:13 - Zooms into the tree, so we can see individually labelled tips.
* 0:13 - 0:19 - Hover over and click on tips to show metadata in right hand panel. This comes from an accompanying metadata.tsv file.
* 0:19 - 0:23 - Drag in the first sub tree. This is a 100 node tree generated by Copilot as a subtree of the main Pruned tree. It is artifical test data used to explain the ideas, not a biologically correct sample.
* 0:23 - 0:25 - We zoom into the tips of the loaded subtree - in green. The zoom is automatic when loading a subtree.
* 0:25 - 0:31 - Load a second subtree - again artificially created from the main tree, but with a deliberate overlap with the first subtree. The new tree is rendered in pink. The tips that exist in both subtrees are rendered in black. Zooms to show both trees automatically.
* 0:31 - 0:40 - Lists the overlapping tips.
* 0:40 - 0:47 - Shows only the overlapping tips.
* 0:47 - 0:51 - Resets zoom to whole tree. Can just see the pink and green subtrees.
* 0:51 - 1:02 - Zoom in to the subtrees again
* 1:02 - 1:09 - Stretch the subtrees horizontally to make them clearer to see.
